propositions: The macOS pytest job (py3.13) consumes 15.4m of 18.6m total run time due to coverage collection tracing overhead, while ubuntu cells enforce identical coverage floor over identical test selection.

macOS runner concurrency is capped (peak 4 concurrent observed) causing later changes to queue 6.7-8.4m waiting for runner availability, making macOS job duration doubly valuable as both critical path and scarce-resource bottleneck.
Coverage collection on macOS cells is duplicate work: the identical 7856 tests execute on all matrix OSes but only ubuntu coverage numbers are consumed (enforcing fail_under=70).
Conditional coverage flags per-OS in the matrix will remove tracing cost from macOS cells without losing coverage enforcement, reducing macOS job duration and runner queue time.
